description: This file defines the final class OrderChangeHelper in the package org.apache.ofbiz.order.order. It contains static helper methods for managing order status changes such as approval, rejection, completion, cancellation, and related operations like inventory and payment handling within the OFBiz framework. The class interacts with various OFBiz services, entities, and utilities to perform non-read actions on orders.

classes.name: OrderChangeHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage order status transitions and associated processes like inventory and payment handling.

methods.name: approveOrder
methods.description: Approves an order by updating its status, optionally holding the order depending on the holdOrder flag.

methods.name: rejectOrder
methods.description: Rejects an order by updating its status to declined, and cancels inventory reservations and payment authorizations.

methods.name: completeOrder
methods.description: Completes an order by creating payments, invoices, and updating order and item statuses.

methods.name: cancelOrder
methods.description: Cancels an order by updating statuses, releasing reserved inventory, and payment holds.

methods.name: orderStatusChanges
methods.description: Performs the status change on the order header, order items, and digital items, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: cancelInventoryReservations
methods.description: Cancels inventory reservations for an order.

methods.name: releasePaymentAuthorizations
methods.description: Releases payment authorizations for an order.

methods.name: createReceivedPayments
methods.description: Creates receipt payments based on payment preferences when payments are received.

methods.name: createOrderInvoice
methods.description: Generates an invoice for the given order.
